strings.zh: 温暖的泉水冲刷着身体,{NEWLINE}感觉整个人都放松了。
strings.en: The warm spring water washes over you.{NEWLINE}Every muscle relaxes.
strings.notes: Hot-spring scene with Sabrina (Mt. Silver rehab, cf. 0541). Player variants: male #2 → #5 → #7; female #3 → #6 → #8.

strings.zh: 娜姿『你看起来泡的很享受嘛。
strings.en: Sabrina: You certainly seem to be{NEWLINE}enjoying your soak.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『啊啊……娜姿小姐！{NEWLINE}你怎么也下来泡了！？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Wh-whoa... Sabrina! What are{NEWLINE}you doing in the water too?!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『娜姿小姐也想要{NEWLINE}泡一下这个舒服的温泉吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sabrina, do you want to soak{NEWLINE}in this nice hot spring too?

strings.zh: 娜姿『陪你做了这么久的康复锻炼,{NEWLINE}我也是需要泡泡温泉放松一下的。
strings.en: Sabrina: I have spent a long time{NEWLINE}helping you with your rehabilitation.{SCROLL}I need a soak to unwind as well.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可是我们这样在一起泡……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: But the two of us, soaking{NEWLINE}together like this...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嘿嘿,谢谢娜姿小姐啦。{NEWLINE}白银山的温泉这么棒,{CLEAR}你也多泡一会儿吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Heh heh, thanks, Sabrina. The{NEWLINE}hot springs on Mt. Silver are amazing.{SCROLL}Stay and soak a while longer.

strings.zh: 娜姿『可什么是啊！{NEWLINE}跟我一起泡温泉很难为你吗？
strings.en: Sabrina: But what? Is sharing a hot{NEWLINE}spring with me so hard for you?

strings.zh: 娜姿『是呀,等我回金黄市之后,{NEWLINE}就会有很多日常的公务来烦我了。{CLEAR}在那之前我可要{CLEAR}好好泡个温泉放松一下。
strings.en: Sabrina: Indeed.{SCROLL}Once I return to Saffron City, I will be{NEWLINE}buried in Gym business again.{SCROLL}Before that, I intend to have a good,{NEWLINE}long soak.

strings.zh: 娜姿『呼,轻松多了！{SCROLL}娜姿『{VAR:0103:0},我现在要回去了。{NEWLINE}但你不要急着离开白银山,{CLEAR}在这里多住段时间之后再走,{CLEAR}这样才能确保彻底恢复。{SCROLL}娜姿『希望下次见到你的时候,{NEWLINE}你能变得更加惊艳。
strings.en: Sabrina: Phew, that is much better!{SCROLL}Sabrina: {VAR:0103:0}, I am going back now.{NEWLINE}But do not rush to leave Mt. Silver.{SCROLL}Stay a while longer before you go.{SCROLL}That is the only way to be sure you{NEWLINE}recover fully.{SCROLL}Sabrina: I hope that the next time I{NEWLINE}see you, you will be even more dazzling.

strings.zh: 就这样,{VAR:0103:0}在白银山{NEWLINE}又住了一段时间后,{CLEAR}回到了真新镇。
strings.en: And so, after staying on Mt. Silver a{NEWLINE}while longer, {VAR:0103:0} returned to{CLEAR}Pallet Town.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『泡温泉的话……{NEWLINE}还是把精灵收起来比较好吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If I’m going to soak in the hot{NEWLINE}spring...{SCROLL}I’d better put my Pokémon away.

strings.zh: 准备要离开温泉了吗？
strings.en: Ready to leave the hot spring?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}泡完温泉之后,{NEWLINE}又在白银山休养了一段时间。
strings.en: After the hot spring, {VAR:0103:0} rested{NEWLINE}on Mt. Silver for a while longer.

strings.zh: 渡『这两年来,{NEWLINE}你一直都藏身在这里吗？{CLEAR}坂木！
strings.en: Lance: Is this where you’ve been hiding{NEWLINE}these past two years, Giovanni?!
strings.notes: Mt. Silver, before the Silver Conference: Lance and Lorelei vs. Giovanni; Adamant Orb reveal (#51).

strings.zh: 科拿『还是说你是今天{NEWLINE}特意来到白银山,{CLEAR}想要在白银大会上搞破坏？
strings.en: Lorelei: Or did you come to Mt. Silver{NEWLINE}today to wreck the Silver Conference?

strings.zh: 坂木『要向我问话？{NEWLINE}你们还没这个资格。
strings.en: Giovanni: You wish to question me?{NEWLINE}Neither of you has earned that right.

strings.zh: 渡『不管你的目的是什么,{NEWLINE}今天你都休想离开这里！
strings.en: Lance: Whatever you’re after, you’re{NEWLINE}not leaving here today!

strings.zh: 渡『快龙！{NEWLINE}科拿『铁甲贝！
strings.en: Lance: Dragonite!{NEWLINE}Lorelei: Cloyster!

strings.zh: 坂木『哼。
strings.en: Giovanni: Hmph.

strings.zh: 渡『咳……咳……！{NEWLINE}出手速度比原来更快了！？
strings.en: Lance: *cough*... *cough*...! He’s{NEWLINE}even faster than before?!

strings.zh: 科拿『可恶……受伤了吗……{NEWLINE}这攻击穿透力真强啊,呕……
strings.en: Lorelei: Damn... Am I hurt...? That{NEWLINE}attack went right through... Urgh...

strings.zh: 坂木『你们两个活着就是绊脚石,{NEWLINE}还是早早地给我消失吧。
strings.en: Giovanni: As long as you two live, you{NEWLINE}are in my way.{SCROLL}Disappear, and be quick about it.

strings.zh: 渡『咳……别以为靠着先声夺人,{NEWLINE}就能轻松打败我们……咳……！
strings.en: Lance: *cough*...{SCROLL}Don’t think one first strike is enough{NEWLINE}to beat us... *cough*...!

strings.zh: 科拿『我们身上带的精灵,{NEWLINE}可……可不只这1只呢……
strings.en: Lorelei: That’s... not the only Pokémon{NEWLINE}we brought...

strings.zh: 坂木『好啊,那就让我看看{NEWLINE}你们拖着受伤的身体能坚持多久。
strings.en: Giovanni: Very well. Let us see how long{NEWLINE}you last with those wounds.

strings.zh: 渡『咳……唔……,化石翼龙{NEWLINE}就决定是你……
strings.en: Lance: *cough*... Ngh... Aerodactyl, I{NEWLINE}choose...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『渡先生不必勉强了,{NEWLINE}让我来对付坂木吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t push yourself, Lance.{NEWLINE}Let me handle Giovanni.

strings.zh: 渡『太好了,{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}我算着……咳……{CLEAR}你也差不多该到了。
strings.en: Lance: Great, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}I figured... *cough*... you’d be showing{NEWLINE}up about now.

strings.zh: 科拿『虽然你以前……咳{NEWLINE}打败过坂木,{CLEAR}但是他现在好像变得更强了,{CLEAR}咳咳……你自己没有问题吗？
strings.en: Lorelei: You’ve... *cough*... beaten{NEWLINE}Giovanni before.{SCROLL}But he seems even stronger now. *cough{NEWLINE}cough*... Will you be all right?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没问题的,{NEWLINE}我也比以前更强了。{CLEAR}你们二位先专心包扎伤口就好,{CLEAR}剩下的交给我吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ll be fine. I’ve gotten{NEWLINE}stronger too.{SCROLL}You two just focus on your wounds.{NEWLINE}Leave the rest to me.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『坂木,咱们又见面了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Giovanni, we meet again.

strings.zh: 坂木『嗯……不错嘛,{NEWLINE}你的眼神看起来{CLEAR}比两年前又成熟了不少。
strings.en: Giovanni: Hmm... Not bad.{SCROLL}Your eyes look far more mature than{NEWLINE}they did two years ago.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我们在卡吉镇的火箭队基地{NEWLINE}没有发现你去过的迹象,{CLEAR}整个基地的指挥体系{CLEAR}都是阿波罗在负责。{CLEAR}也就是说你这两年来{CLEAR}没有亲自指挥过火箭队？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: We found no sign of you at the{NEWLINE}Team Rocket base in Mahogany Town.{SCROLL}Archer was running the whole show.{SCROLL}So you haven’t led Team Rocket yourself{NEWLINE}for the last two years?

strings.zh: 坂木『没错,这两年来{NEWLINE}我一直在破解一个谜题。
strings.en: Giovanni: Correct. For two years now, I{NEWLINE}have been working on a riddle.
{VAR:0103:0}: A riddle?

strings.zh: 坂木『想知道吗？{NEWLINE}那就用你的实力来问吧！
strings.en: Giovanni: You wish to know? Then ask{NEWLINE}with your strength!

strings.zh: 坂木『不错嘛,还是一如既往地强啊！
strings.en: Giovanni: Not bad. As strong as ever!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『怎么不打了？{NEWLINE}你应该还有两只精灵吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Why’d you stop? You should{NEWLINE}still have two Pokémon left.

strings.zh: 坂木『这已经是我个人的极限了,{NEWLINE}如果不使用传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}我是无法战胜你的。
strings.en: Giovanni: That is my limit on my own.{SCROLL}Without legendary Pokémon, I cannot{NEWLINE}defeat you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你还有两只传说中的精灵！？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You have two more legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon?!

strings.zh: 坂木『那倒没有,{NEWLINE}我身上剩余的两只精灵{CLEAR}是大针蜂和绅士鸦。
strings.en: Giovanni: I do not. The two Pokémon I{NEWLINE}have left are Beedrill and Honchkrow.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『所以你这是……放弃了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So you’re... giving up?

strings.zh: 坂木『如何让南方小岛的石室里{NEWLINE}飘进天降的雪花,{CLEAR}你想过这个问题没有？
strings.en: Giovanni: How would you make snow fall{NEWLINE}from the sky into a stone chamber on a{CLEAR}small southern island?{SCROLL}Have you ever pondered that?
strings.notes: Giovanni's riddle (snow falling into a stone chamber on a southern island) kept literal; the payoff is outside this batch.

strings.zh: 坂木『我在走遍了关东城都各地,{NEWLINE}最终让我发现,{CLEAR}解开谜题的关键就在白银山。
strings.en: Giovanni: I traveled all over Kanto and{NEWLINE}Johto.{SCROLL}In the end, I found that the key to the{NEWLINE}riddle lies on Mt. Silver.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你该不会说{NEWLINE}要把白银山搬到南方小岛去吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t tell me you want to move{NEWLINE}Mt. Silver to a southern island?

strings.zh: 坂木『聪明！{NEWLINE}虽然不完全正确,但也很接近了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Clever! Not entirely right,{NEWLINE}but close.

strings.zh: 坂木『白银山上藏着一个东西,{NEWLINE}就是解开这个谜题的第一把钥匙。{CLEAR}就在几天前,{CLEAR}我终于在这里找到了这个东西。{CLEAR}经过反复确认后,{CLEAR}肯定就是它没错了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Something is hidden on{NEWLINE}Mt. Silver: the first key to this riddle.{SCROLL}Just days ago, I finally found it here. I{NEWLINE}checked again and again.{SCROLL}There is no doubt.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你说的到底什么东西。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What exactly are you talking{NEWLINE}about?

strings.zh: 坂木『告诉你也无妨,{NEWLINE}我找到的那个东西就是{CLEAR}「金刚宝珠」。
strings.en: Giovanni: There is no harm in telling{NEWLINE}you.{SCROLL}What I found... is the Adamant Orb.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『金刚宝珠？那是什么？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The Adamant Orb? What’s that?

strings.zh: 渡『那是传说中{NEWLINE}寄宿着时间之力的宝珠,{CLEAR}根据神奥地区的传说{CLEAR}只要拿着它就能见到{CLEAR}掌控时间的精灵帝牙卢卡。
strings.en: Lance: It’s a legendary orb said to{NEWLINE}hold the power of time.{SCROLL}According to Sinnoh legend, whoever{NEWLINE}holds it can meet Dialga, the Pokémon{CLEAR}that rules time.

strings.zh: 科拿『可是这跟让南方小岛下雪{NEWLINE}有什么关系吗？
strings.en: Lorelei: But what does that have to do{NEWLINE}with snow on a southern island?

strings.zh: 坂木『这只是第一把钥匙,{NEWLINE}我将用它来开启{CLEAR}接下来的一连串因果连锁,{CLEAR}你们就等着看火箭队君临天下吧！{SCROLL}坂木『哈哈哈哈哈哈！
strings.en: Giovanni: This is only the first key.{SCROLL}With it, I will set off a whole chain of{NEWLINE}cause and effect.{SCROLL}Just wait and watch Team Rocket rule{NEWLINE}the world!{SCROLL}Giovanni: Hah hah hah hah hah hah!
{VAR:0103:0}: Stop right there!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『唉……又让他跑了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ugh... He got away again.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『渡先生、科拿女士,{NEWLINE}你们的伤怎么样了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Lance, Lorelei, how are your{NEWLINE}wounds?

strings.zh: 渡『经过紧急包扎之后{NEWLINE}已经没有大碍了。
strings.en: Lance: We’ve patched ourselves up.{NEWLINE}Nothing serious.

strings.zh: 科拿『刚刚多亏了你啊,{NEWLINE}不然还真是凶险呢。
strings.en: Lorelei: Good thing you were here. That{NEWLINE}was a close one.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『真没想到在白银大会前夕{NEWLINE}会发生这样的事。{CLEAR}大会……还要继续召开吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I never expected this right{NEWLINE}before the Silver Conference.{SCROLL}Is the Conference... still going ahead?

strings.zh: 渡『稍等,我跟主席通个电话,{NEWLINE}请示一下他的意见。
strings.en: Lance: Hold on. I’ll call the President{NEWLINE}and ask for his instructions.

strings.zh: 渡『喂,主席您好,{NEWLINE}有件重要的事需要向您紧急汇报一下。{CLEAR}我和{VAR:0103:0}、科拿{CLEAR}在白银山遇到了坂木,{CLEAR}事情是这样的……
strings.en: Lance: Hello, Mr. President. I have{NEWLINE}something urgent to report.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, Lorelei and I ran into Giovanni{NEWLINE}on Mt. Silver. Here’s what happened...

strings.zh: 渡『好的,我明白您的意思了。
strings.en: Lance: Understood, sir.

strings.zh: 渡『主席下达指示了,{NEWLINE}我们不能因为火箭队的干扰{CLEAR}就取消白银大会,{CLEAR}一切按计划进行。{CLEAR}对于坂木出现在这里的事,{CLEAR}为了避免不必要的恐慌,{CLEAR}大家都不要对外界提起,{CLEAR}明白了吗？
strings.en: Lance: The President has given his{NEWLINE}orders.{SCROLL}We won’t cancel the Silver Conference{NEWLINE}because of Team Rocket.{SCROLL}Everything goes ahead as planned.{SCROLL}As for Giovanni turning up here, to{NEWLINE}avoid needless panic, none of us is to{CLEAR}mention it to anyone.{SCROLL}Understood?
{VAR:0103:0}: Understood.

strings.zh: 科拿『一切按主席说的办。
strings.en: Lorelei: We’ll do as the President says.

strings.zh: 呀！渡先生、科拿女士,{NEWLINE}还有冠军大人,{CLEAR}你们怎么还在这儿啊。{CLEAR}白银大会马上就要开始了,{CLEAR}请各位快点就位吧！
strings.en: Oh! Lance, Lorelei, and the Champion{NEWLINE}too! What are you still doing here?{SCROLL}The Silver Conference is about to{NEWLINE}start.{SCROLL}Please take your places, quickly!

strings.zh: 渡『不好意思,{NEWLINE}刚才有事耽误了一下。{CLEAR}我们这就过去。
strings.en: Lance: Sorry, something held us up.{NEWLINE}We’ll be right there.
